title: Pocketwire Rewards Member Loyalty Relief on Clawbacks
content:
Long-standing Pocketwire Rewards members with sustained card spend receive a loyalty relief on the points clawed back after a merchant refund.

## Rule

The clawback loyalty relief is 750 points when the membership has completed at least 4 whole years and the clawback relief spend is at least 40000 USD; it is 300 points when the member does not meet that first condition but the membership has completed at least 2 whole years and the clawback relief spend is at least 15000 USD; and it is nothing otherwise.

The relief is taken off the clawback for the refund, and a clawback is never reduced below zero; on tiers where the clawback is cut to the points balance, the cut applies to the clawback after the relief has been taken off.

## Definitions

- The clawback relief spend is the spend carried by earning entries dated within the last twelve months less the spend carried by clawback entries dated within the same twelve months.
- Earning entries are the entries that credit base and category points on a card purchase; boost entries, which carry the same purchase's spend, are not earning entries.
- A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.
- The membership's whole years are the whole months from the enrolment date to the handling date divided by twelve and rounded down.

## Relief by years and spend

| Whole years of membership | Clawback relief spend | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| 4 or more | 40000 USD or more | 750 points |
| 4 or more | 15000 USD or more, below 40000 USD | 300 points |
| 2 or 3 | 15000 USD or more | 300 points |
| 2 or more | below 15000 USD | nothing |
| fewer than 2 | any | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- 5 whole years and a relief spend of 38000 USD: the first condition fails on spend; 2 or more years and at least 15000 USD give 300 points.
- 3 whole years and a relief spend of 50000 USD: the first condition fails on years; the relief is 300 points.
- A clawback of 280 points with a relief of 300 points is reduced to 0 points, never below zero.
